name: icon-tile
description: Centered line icon over a short label on a light panel tile; the whole tile is a link.

Icons map: globe/book-open/shopping-cart -> assets/svg/fischer/sec-1-teaser-icon-*.svg; phone-call/users/info -> assets/svg/fischertechnik/sec-9-*.svg; phone -> assets/svg/fischer/footer-icon-phone.svg.
